title: Synthetic conforming fixture that requires an extension no evaluator supports
description: Constructed staged fixture that is a fully conforming document and declares one required extension, a probe name that no implementation is expected to support. Synthetic content for specification testing; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Present an evaluator with a conforming pack whose required extension it does not support, so that no disposition may be produced.
decision.question: Should this synthetic request be approved or held?

evidenceRequirements.description: The synthetic intake form for the request.

rules.description: Approve the request once it is marked ready.
Hold the request while it is marked not ready.

com.example.unsupported-probe.note: A required extension exists to change what a pack means. This one carries no meaning; it exists so that an evaluator must refuse.
